description: Feux de circulation – emplacements toutes intersections is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Ce fichier contient l’emplacement de tous les feux de circulation gérés par la Ville de Montréal. Le fichier contient le numéro de référence de l’intersection où se situe le feu, le nom des deux rues qui forment l’intersection et les coordonnées géographiques du point central de l’intersection. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Circulation, Coordonnées géoréférencées, Feu, Feu tricolor, Intersection. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
